canonical_identity.authoritative_game_source: the hash-bound certified official schedule or game-identity release named by the active request authority
requirements: game_pk is a positive integer present exactly once in the expected certified game universe
game_pk resolves to one certified official date and one home and away official team ID
row game_date exactly equals the certified official date
inning_topbot is exactly Top or Bot and binds batting side to away or home respectively
the opposing fielding side is derived from the same certified game identity
batter and pitcher are positive MLB identity values
every row retains its original home_team and away_team source labels without rewriting

validation_algorithm: load only the hash-bound certified game universe before reading row identity fields
reject any requested or observed game_pk outside that exact universe
resolve certified official date plus home and away official team IDs by game_pk
require each raw row game_date to equal the certified official date
derive batting and fielding official team IDs from inning_topbot and certified side
retain the raw home_team and away_team strings as source observations
report every difference between raw labels and separately certified display labels without using either display label as identity
require one internally consistent raw home and away label pair per game_pk while retaining that pair verbatim
emit canonical identity fields only into quarantined validation output until the governing source contract is independently confirmed

versioned_source_label_mapping.derivation_requirement: derive only from certified game identity and side across an independently qualified source population

fail_closed_conditions: missing or ambiguous certified game identity
game_pk outside the exact expected universe
missing or invalid home or away official team ID
home and away official team IDs are equal
more than one raw home and away label pair within one game_pk
any attempt to use raw abbreviation text as canonical identity
any mutation of retained raw team labels or response bytes
